neighbours.label: the conjunction ' and' joining two words or phrases
fire: The soup was hot and spicy, just as the menu promised.
Bring a towel and sunscreen if you plan to swim.
The old house felt dark and empty after the move.
She speaks French and German with equal ease.
The trail is steep and rocky near the summit.
He fixed the fence and painted the shed on Sunday.
Our neighbours keep chickens and goats behind the barn.
The lecture was long and confusing for most students.
quiet: The soup was hot but bland, despite what the menu promised.
Bring a towel or sunscreen if you plan to swim.
The old house felt dark, almost empty, after the move.
She speaks French with equal ease in every setting.
The trail is steep near the summit, so take care.
He fixed the fence before lunch on Sunday.
Our neighbours keep chickens behind the red barn.
The lecture was long, yet clear for most students.

notes: Card: ' and' x30 of top 32; flagged broad. Probe: 'warm and quiet' 0.33, 'apples and pears' 0.31, 'but' 0.01, 'or' 0.00.
